scenes.name: hook
scenes.text: You save a file to the cloud, drop your phone in water, and the file is still safe. Where is it really kept?

scenes.name: upload
scenes.text: Your file travels over the internet, encrypted, to the company's data centres. Huge buildings full of servers.

scenes.name: chunks
scenes.text: Large files are often split into chunks, and stored across many drives.

scenes.name: copies
scenes.text: Each piece is stored more than once, on different machines, often in different locations. If one drive dies, another copy takes over.

scenes.name: encrypt
scenes.text: Major providers also encrypt your files while they're stored, so a stolen drive alone is useless.

scenes.name: sync
scenes.text: When you edit a file, the app usually uploads just the changes, then updates it on your other devices.

scenes.name: you
scenes.text: The weakest link is often your password. Turn on two factor authentication to keep the account safe.

scenes.name: outro
scenes.text: Upload, split, copy, sync. Your files, somewhere safe. Follow for more on how things really work.
